ideas.title: FBI Investigation into Ohio Voting Rights Group Raises Concerns about Voter Suppression
ideas.description: This story would investigate the FBI's search of the Ohio voting rights group's offices and the potential implications for voter suppression.
ideas.angle: The angle of this story would be to examine the potential motivations behind the FBI's investigation and the impact on voting rights in Ohio.
questions: What were the reasons for the FBI's search?
How might this investigation impact voting rights in Ohio?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it raises concerns about the potential for voter suppression and the role of law enforcement in investigating non-profit organizations.

ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would examine the growing concern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts to investigate and prosecute these crimes.
ideas.angle: The angle of this story would be to look at the specific cases of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the impact on the state's healthcare system.
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the consequences for those found guilty of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it highlights the need for accountability in the healthcare system and the importance of investigating and prosecuting Medicaid fraud.
